g.text: Selected code relationships: 77 declared inputs, 12 cards
A square means membership in a reviewed code card; it is not a correlation coefficient.
Cards contain selected inputs, not complete dependency closure. Blank cells do not prove independence.
[bound] denotes an alias, not an additional independent input. Formula, units and code anchors: curated_relations.json.
